page.notes: The ligature ƈ (ct) is rendered as printed. The word after "superventurus" is read as "sit" but is doubtful (marked [?]). The side note "Quum enim]" is set in italic and sits in the left margin at the first line. The final line ends "be-" at the foot of the page; the continuation is not on this page and no catchword is printed. A small mark at the foot centre is a printer's or scanning mark and is not transcribed. Printed errors left as they are: none certain.
